data.one_liner: Embedded NoSQL database for Dart and Flutter with LSM storage, ACID transactions, and encryption.
data.what_it_does: Provides a pure Dart embedded NoSQL database featuring a write-ahead log, queries, indexes, ACID transactions, AES-256-GCM encryption, TTL, and change streams. Runs without native dependencies across mobile, desktop, and the Dart VM.
use_when: You need an embedded NoSQL database in pure Dart with query capabilities and ACID transactions
You require secure AES-256-GCM encryption for stored data
You need live updates and change streams to rebuild your UI
avoid_when: You require the absolute fastest iteration over everything stored compared to Hive
strengths: Every write is flushed to disk before returning by default
Supports queries, indexes, and ACID transactions
Pure Dart with no native dependencies and optional background isolate execution
weaknesses: Does not run on the web
Opening takes longer and memory usage grows if keepInMemory is used
data.setup_notes: No native dependencies or code generation required. Add the package to pubspec and initialize with an absolute path or ReaxFlutter.

alternatives.name: hive
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick Hive if you need web support or maximum iteration speed over stored values.

alternatives.name: sqflite
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick sqflite if you prefer a traditional SQLite relational database.

alternatives.name: drift
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick drift if you want a type-safe SQL database builder for Dart and Flutter.
